description: This Java class defines the SendMessageAcceptedResponse, a command response class related to messaging in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, and encapsulates response metadata such as headers, status codes, and message identifiers.

classes.name: SendMessageAcceptedResponse
classes.description: Final class representing the 'acceptance' response to a message command, extending AbstractMessageCommandResponse. It includes constants for message type, factory methods for creation from parameters and JSON, and helper methods for headers and correlation ID.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance with specified thing ID, message headers, status code, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing necessary fields to construct the response object.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID from the Ditto headers, if present.
